summary: Iteration 48 frontend E2E test of the rebuilt Step-4 Proposed Solution solar calculator + Company Profile Sales Copy tab + Detailed/Kit PDF sales documents. Backend POST /api/calculate/quick spot-checked (200, correct schema). All 12 Case A numbers matched to the rupee (Total ₹2,05,150, Net ₹1,27,150, Monthly saving ₹3,000, Payback 3.5 yrs, panels ₹93,150, inverter ₹46,000, BOS 66000, subsidy input value exactly '78000' no leading zero, subsidy-hint mentions ₹78,000). Overrides & reset work (Manually set chip, panel count recompute, click reset restores auto). Roof cap 200 sq ft → 2 kW with warning; clear → back to 3. Commercial toggle removes PM Surya Ghar hint. Empty-bill state shows calc-waiting-bill + placeholder in result strip; no NaN anywhere. Hybrid worked case C matches (battery count 5, line-battery ₹1,29,375, panel 10, backup hint 'Needs 8 kWh of storage'); grid→hybrid switch has NO dialog. System-type switch guard works: hybrid→on-grid shows dialog listing 'battery item id', cancel keeps battery, confirm clears it and keeps panel/inverter; on-grid→Solar Pump shows dialog, confirm reveals pump-flow-section with disabled pump-calculate-btn and missing-fields hint. State survives Prev→Next (bill 3000, subsidy 78000, panel count 6, net-cost ₹1,27,150 all preserved). Mobile 360×800: single column, no horizontal overflow. Pump calculate flow: with page.fill, values 60/40/150/400/300 → Array 1.36 kWp, Pump 2 HP, Cost ₹88,400, Net ₹68,255. Company Profile → Sales Copy tab saves founded_year=2015, sales-phone=9876543210, warranty headline, 2 certifications, 2 financing options. GET /api/company/active returns them parsed correctly (certifications array of strings, financing_options array of {title,description}). Downloaded Detailed & Kit PDFs (both ~1MB, 4 pages each); pypdf text contains all required strings (YOU PAY, YOU SAVE, PAYBACK, Why Sensoper Controls & Renewables, What 25 years costs, YOUR NEXT STEP, Terms used:, headline 'Cut TEST48's electricity bill by ₹3,000'). Detailed also has Site & electrical details / Sanctioned load / Price breakdown / GST rows. NO literal ₹NaN, undefined, or null. Kit contains 'Ways to pay' + 'Zero-cost EMI' + 'Staged payment' (financing options from Sales Copy tab), and does NOT contain TAX INVOICE / HSN/SAC. Invoice PDF could not be tested end-to-end: draft project returned 'This project has no confirmed cost data to invoice' from POST /api/invoices/generate — this requires the project to be reviewed & confirmed first (workflow outside iter 48 scope). PDF invoice-text-content assertions therefore NOT verified.

minor.issue: Returned 400 'This project has no confirmed cost data to invoice' for a freshly-submitted-for-review project — invoice generation blocked so the new GST-Invoice PDF template could not be re-verified in this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: Every number input in the pump path (Required flow, Head, Bore diameter, Controller max voltage, String voltage) remounts on each keystroke, so keyboard.type at any pace (even 50ms/char delay + 150ms settle) only records the first character. Real users typing manually will see multi-digit numbers get truncated to a single digit and have to click back into the field for every digit. Grid-solar inputs on the same screen (bill/units/tariff/subsidy) do NOT have this issue — they accept multi-digit typing normally. page.fill / setting el.value programmatically works, which confirms the input itself is fine — a parent is being re-keyed/re-rendered on every state change.

With bore diameter 150 mm typed as a single '1' the warning read 'Bore casing 1.0mm too narrow for 0.5 HP submersible (needs ≥ 90mm)'. The formatting '1.0mm' should probably be '1 mm' or '1.0 mm' (missing space). Cosmetic.

action_items: Fix PumpFlow inputs re-mounting on every keystroke — likely a component being defined inside the parent's render or keyed by a value that changes with each keystroke. Users cannot enter multi-digit pump numbers today.

(Optional) Verify GST-Invoice PDF text once the project is confirmed / has cost data — the new template's compliance strings (TAX INVOICE, HSN/SAC, CGST/SGST, GRAND TOTAL, Amount in words, Declaration, Terms used:, plus absence of promo copy) still need real-file verification.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/components/calc/PumpFlow.js almost certainly declares an input component or key at render time (or spreads a new object into onChange) causing React to unmount/remount inputs every state tick — this is a real regression, not just a test-script issue.

success_rate.frontend: ≈92% — 12/13 requested UI scenarios pass; pump-input focus bug + invoice-PDF text not verifiable

For solar calculator inputs, keyboard.type works for grid-solar fields (bill-input, units-input, tariff-input, system-size-input, subsidy-input) but for PumpFlow inputs you MUST use page.fill (or the test will only capture the first digit). rca_of_the_issue: PumpFlow keystroke focus loss: page.fill sets the value once and the input value survives, but per-keystroke input drops focus after every char (verified by slow-typing '60' with 150 ms between chars and still only capturing '6'). Root cause is almost certainly in /app/frontend/src/components/calc/PumpFlow.js — likely a functional child component being declared inside the render, an inline useMemo/useState reset, or a container keyed by a changing value, causing the entire pump form to remount on every state change. Grid-solar inputs share the same wizard shell but do not exhibit the bug, so the fault is inside PumpFlow specifically.
